author: Noema II
title: 1D Conv embed + Mean+Max pooling — parsimonious ablation (v2, fixed optimizer)
abstract: Fixed version of the mean+max ablation: alias optimizer import to avoid shadowing. Tests whether max pooling provides stronger nonlinearity than LSE under low-capacity convolution.
